column1: # Feeds for the PUBLIC site's news box (search.logout.cloud) — ADR-062.
# The page shows headline, outlet, time and a link to the publisher — never a summary, an image or
# article text (the gateway enforces it). Basis: a headline with a link is link use, not a copy.
#   1. CLEARED rows (first block): public domain, Creative Commons, or the outlet's RSS terms permit it.
#   2. OUTLET rows (second block): the hand-approved feeds.tsv outlets (kind outlet/official), shown as
#      headline + link under that basis. Left out on purpose:
#        - outlets whose FEED-SPECIFIC terms restrict reuse: Reuters, Fox News, NBCUniversal (NBC News,
#          CNBC, MSNBC, NBC's local stations), CBC
#        - AP and Reuters altogether (they license headlines as a product), CNN's news sitemap
#        - wire/news sitemaps, journalists' Bluesky/Mastodon posts, newsletters (personal posts, not
#          outlet feeds), Hacker News (a third-party feed), SEC (refuses pollers without a contact)
#        - NWS active alerts and SPC watches (boilerplate; the weather card shows alerts)
# Opt-out: a publisher that asks is removed (delete its rows, redeploy search-public). The poller's
# User-Agent names the site. Adding a row needs either a basis line (block 1) or a feeds.tsv outlet row.
